summary: Topics Production wide-screen utilization correction. Owner identified that the V2.47.155 single-column Editorial / Reference Index leaves a large empty right half on desktop. V2.47.156 preserves the existing compact Editorial / Reference Index grammar but uses a two-column index above 1080px so real topic content occupies both halves of the canvas; each item remains a compact cover + title/metadata row rather than a dashboard/card wall, and the layout returns to one column below 1080px. Shared Shell, Navigation, frozen Channels and Watch, other product bodies, data model, schema, migration, auth/security, provider and updater mechanism are unchanged. OWNER_DIRECT_RELEASE applies; Production remains Owner manual.
